{{nihongo|'''Takefutsu Nishinomiya Shrine'''|建布都西宮神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

'''Takefutsu Nishinomiya Shrine''' (たけふつにしのみやじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} enshrined in {{ill|Donari-chō Kōri|ja|土成町郡|qid=Q28692234}}, {{ill|Awa, Tokushima|Q791587|qid=Q791587}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}.

=== History ===
Its founding year is unknown. According to ''Awa Gunshi'', "During the Bun'an era, the local lord Harada Yamato-no-kami lamented its ruin and repaired the shrine buildings, also dedicating one sacred mirror as a treasure," suggesting the shrine had already declined in the {{ill|Muromachi period|ar|فترة موروماتشي|ast|Periodu Muromachi|bcl|Panahon nin Muromachi|be|Перыяд Мурамаці|bg|Муромачи|bn|মুরোমাচি যুগ|ckb|سەردەمی مرۆماچی|cs|Období Muromači|de|Muromachi-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Muromaĉi|es|Período Muromachi|eu|Muromachi aroa|fa|دوره موروماچی|fi|Muromachi-kausi|fr|Époque de Muromachi|gl|Período Muromachi|he|תקופת אשיקאגה|hu|Muromacsi-kor|id|Zaman Muromachi|it|Periodo Muromachi|ja|室町時代|ko|무로마치 시대|lt|Muromači laikotarpis|nl|Muromachiperiode|pl|Muromachi (okres)|pt|Período Muromachi|ru|Период Муромати|simple|Muromachi period|sk|Obdobie Muromači|sl|Obdobje Muromači|sr|Муромачи период|sv|Ashikaga|th|ยุคมูโรมาจิ|tl|Panahong Muromachi|tr|Muromachi Dönemi|uk|Період Муроматі|vi|Thời kỳ Muromachi|wuu|室町时代|zh|室町时代|zh_min_nan|Muromati sî-tāi|zh_yue|室町時代|qid=Q334845}} and was later revived.

It is one of the candidate shrines for Takefutsu Shrine listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}; the other candidate is {{ill|Takefutsu Shrine|ja|建布都神社|qid=Q48758365}} in {{ill|Ichiba-chō Kami|Q47393149|qid=Q47393149}}, Awa City. It was once also called Sugiō-sha.

In {{ill|2000|Q1985|qid=Q1985}} (Heisei 12), Nishinomiya Shrine was merged. Nishinomiya Shrine is said to have been founded by {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Harada Magoshirō}}, lord of Kōri Castle, who invited a divided spirit of {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611}} from {{ill|Izumo-taisha|Q696362|qid=Q696362}}.

The crest of Takefutsu Shrine is "crossed sword in a circle," while the crest of Nishinomiya Shrine is {{ill|vine gashiwa in a circle|Q65247832|qid=Q65247832|lt=vine gashiwa in a circle}}.

=== Access ===
* About 10 minutes by car from {{ill|Donari interchange|Q10927770|qid=Q10927770}} on the {{ill|Tokushima Expressway|Q11490216|qid=Q11490216}}.
